title: Bridging the Digital Divide: Enhancing Accessibility for Blind and Low-Vision Consumers
summary: McKinsey & Company discusses efforts to close the digital gap specifically for blind and low-vision consumers, focusing on improving digital accessibility and user experience for this demographic.
